title: Nexus ListCharacterTomQuery
description: Query string for GET /v1/daemon/characters/{character_id}/tom. Reads only carriers owned by the viewer Character or its selected active binding; world-owned and other Characters' carriers are never read.

binding_id.description: The viewer Character's selected active binding in world_id.

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from a previous page. Clients MUST NOT parse it.
